governance.note: miso-48 = the miso-47 keeper recipe re-solved byte-identical at HEAD with ONE offer-curve change: the generic ST_GAS_INTERMEDIATE committed band re-grounded 0.85 -> 1.00x base_HR (backcast_config.py), closing the pjm-83 defect pattern the L-7 audit located (docs/miso-caiso-srmc-floor-audit-2026-07.md SS2): an uncited, ISO-unscoped sub-1.0 multiplier pricing a non-CHP, non-take-or-pay gas tranche ~$3.3-5.2/MWh below its own average-heat-rate fuel cost (the MISO cost-based-offer SRMC floor, Tariff Module C / Attachment L; sanity vs the MISO IMM/Potomac SOM). The class's own comment claims to mirror CT_INTERMEDIATE, whose committed=1.00 design rule ('priced at its own delivered marginal cost') it now actually follows; a steam boiler's part-load HR is monotonically WORSE than average, so 1.0x is a true floor (no CC flat-plateau exception). CC_REGULAR econ_low 0.95 is UNCHANGED (the audit rules it SURVIVES on MISO's own CAMPD flat-body marginal-HR physics). ZERO free parameters added or fitted: the change replaces a residual-lineage value with a tariff-cited bound, so leave-one-year-out degenerates to per-year direction checks - confirmed consistent in all three years independently (ST_GAS -0.6/-0.6/~-0.6 TWh; C3a +0.3/+0.3/+0.3pp toward actuals). Structure fix promoted on correctness (rules 1/11/14): the 2023 ST_GAS C1 row crosses the 8.00 TWh band edge (-7.56 -> -8.16 TWh, PASS -> FAIL) because the sub-SRMC band was silently buying ~0.6 TWh/yr of the G-25 commitment-posture wedge - a discovered root cause now correctly attributed to G-25, NOT a reason to revert to 0.85. Everything else in the miso-47 recipe (seam ladder, reliability drags, reserve co-opt, coal sigmoids) is unchanged; sigmoids NOT re-fit (rule 23).
governance.validation_note: Reproducible from the committed bundle: scripts/run_calibration_full.py --iso MISO --year 2023 2024 2025 --cc-capacity-reconcile --coal-econ-srmc-bound --reliability-floor --coal-prb-sigmoid --coal-mustrun-per-plant --coal-drop-pof --prb-sigmoid-tiered --coal-bit-sigmoid --ct-intermediate-split --cc-intermediate-split --st-gas-intermediate --energy-reserve-coopt --miso-zonal-reserves --miso-reserve-pergen --miso-zonal-gas-basis --reference-price-interface --miso-firm-imports --miso-seam-flow-limit --miso-seam-export-limit --miso-pjm-border-anchor --miso-seam-measured-ladder --out-dir results/calibration/MISO/miso_48_stgas_srmc (git 5eff2b3; ~16 GB peak on a 15 GiB box - completed with a 10 GiB swapfile, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=1 MARKET_SIM_HIGHS_THREADS=1; the G-40 memory datum from miso-46 reproduces). RESULT vs miso-47 (same scorer, rubric v2.2): C1 all 14/16 -> 13/16, free 10/12 -> 9/12 - the single flipped row is 2023 ST_GAS -7.56 -> -8.16 TWh crossing the +/-8.00 TWh band edge; 2024 ST_GAS -10.08 -> -10.72 (already FAIL); 2023 COAL_PRB +8.10 -> +8.80 (pre-existing overrun absorbs the displaced energy; #1347); 2024 CT_PEAKER +3.62 -> +4.00, 2023 CT_PEAKER -2.52 -> -2.19 (both PASS). C3a mean LMP IMPROVES every year: 2023 -0.4% -> -0.1%, 2024 -5.0% -> -4.7%, 2025 -11.0% -> -10.7% (removing the sub-cost committed block lifts the marginal price toward actuals). C2 2025 ~unchanged (coal +16.2 -> +16.4%, gas -14.7 -> -14.6%). C5a CO2 PASS x3 (-1.5/-2.5/+5.1%). D-1/D-2/D-4/D-5/D-9/D-10 all PASS. No unit pinned to observed CEMS generation; no input rescaled to land model output on actuals; 1.00x is the tariff SRMC floor (measured base_HR x delivered gas + VOM), not a value tuned to a residual.

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (benchmark basis mismatch — not a model miss)
exceptions.reason: EIA-930 MISO reports NO pumped-storage series (verified: the PS column is all-null in every scored year of the balance files); the 0.245 TWh actual is battery-only, while the model side includes the 2,417 MW EIA-860 PS fleet (Ludington + Taum Sauk). The model's PS throughput sits INSIDE the eGRID net-energy-implied gross-discharge band (2.5-4.4 TWh depending on RTE basis) — the model is not over-cycling. No adder is admissible (PSH O&M < $1/MWh; the PJM $10 adder precedent in constants.py retired exactly this class of fit-to-mismeasured-target). Closable only in the scorer: compare battery-only model discharge vs NG: BAT when a BA reports battery-only (flagged to rubric infra). Full adjudication: results/calibration/FINDING-miso-c5b-storage-benchmark-2026-07.md.
